problem: Table of Contents emitted dead '#orientation' anchor on 36 stories where no Short Version section was rendered, and dead '#key-findings' in quick mode
evidence: audit-toc-integrity.ts detected 73 dead anchor failures across public stories
root_cause: hasOrientation checked story.summary (always present) rather than structured takeaways, and quick-mode TOC hardcoded anchors regardless of data presence
proposed_fix: Condition hasOrientation and extractTOC on actual orientation model presence; condition quick-mode TOC on keyFindings/sources presence

problem: Mobile readers on screens <1024px had no Table of Contents or section jump mechanism because StoryOrientationRail is hidden on mobile
evidence: Playwright mobile captures showed absence of in-page jump navigation on viewports 375/390/412px
root_cause: StoryOrientationRail used 'hidden lg:block' with no responsive mobile alternative in StoryShell
proposed_fix: Add accessible, collapsible <details> Table of Contents ('On This Page') directly below mode switcher for mobile/tablet screens
verification_method: Playwright mobile inspection and DOM verification

problem: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toLowerCase') when processing sources with 'name' instead of 'title'
evidence: Scripts crashed on stories with un-aliased sources (e.g. accountability-in-india
proposed_fix: presentation-model called s.title.toLowerCase() without null check or fallback to (s as any).name
verification_method: Safely fall back to s.title || (s as any).name || 'Documentary Source'
